market_signals.summary: May 2026 restructuring (Project Foundry) cut 400 positions (25% of workforce) to automate operations, including replacing human merchant outreach with AI voice agents. COO Jiri Ponrt resigned.
market_signals.relevance: Directly explains the mandate for an AI-fluent VP Commercial to drive the new AI sales motion and replace the old org.

market_signals.summary: Yelp acquired RepairPal for $80M in cash in late 2024 to expand its auto services platform.
market_signals.relevance: Shows aggressive expansion in local services by Tier 2 competitor.
